raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart displays the effect sizes of various linguistic features across different language families and isolated languages, with error bars indicating variability. The horizontal axis represents the language family or group, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis, labeled "effect," ranges from 0 to 30, with values increasing in increments of 10. Each category on the horizontal axis contains multiple bars, each corresponding to a different linguistic feature: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bars are grouped by language family, with each group containing up to six bars representing the six features. The heights of the bars vary significantly across categories, with the IE-Indic group showing the highest values, particularly for mBERT-B₂ (approximately 25) and XLM-B₂ (approximately 22). In contrast, the Isolate and Uralic groups show generally lower effect sizes, with most bars near or below 5. The chart includes error bars for each bar, indicating the range of uncertainty or variability in the effect estimates. The bars are not sorted in any apparent numerical or alphabetical order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and position.
